correctness.rationale: The source definition specializes on the triangle-free cube to a unique earlier-neighbor pairing. Exhaustive independent integer-bitmask reconstruction enumerated all 40320 orders and exact downward closure, yielding 216 tetrahedral facets and face counts 24,168,392,216. The delivered script verifies 216 legal elementary free triangle–tetrahedron collapses and a 23-edge spanning tree plus 145 triangular relations eliminating all 145 generators of the fundamental group. Thus the residual 2-complex is simply connected with χ=32, so H2=Z^31 and Hurewicz plus the homology Whitehead theorem implies wedge 31 S2. GF2 ranks 23,145,216 are a crosscheck only, not a substitute for the integer homotopy proof.

The number 31 is forced by the full object rather than an arbitrary parameter slice.
